name: binopsy
description: Read and write binary formats in TypeScript, with types that check how the fields fit together: compiled decoders and encoders, streams and partial decoding
author: Felix Boehm <me@feedic.com>

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --emitDeclarationOnly && rolldown src/index.ts --file lib/index.js --format esm --platform neutral --no-treeshake --comments.annotation --no-comments.jsdoc --no-comments.legal --sourcemap
scripts.lint: npm run build && oxlint && oxfmt --check && tsc && tsc -p test/package && npm run lint:generated
